Definition: Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Jahaz or Jahazah or Jahzah = "trodden down"; 1) a place in Reuben east of the Dead Sea where Israel defeated Sihon king of the Amorites; site uncertain
